standard.summary: 梯度裁剪系数 λ，防止早期步的梯度爆炸。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The gradient clipping coefficient lambda, which prevents gradient explosion on the early steps.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 梯度裁剪系数 λ，防止早期步的梯度爆炸。推荐 0.1 ~ 1.0（默认 0.1）。

advanced_en.principle: Gradient clipping coefficient λ, guarding against early-step gradient explosion. Recommended 0.1 ~ 1.0 (default 0.1).
